2607.09092.title: AgentKGV: Agentic LLM-RAG Framework with Two-Stage Training for the Fact Verification of Knowledge Graphs
2607.09092.paper_summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are often automatically constructed from large-scale corpora, but they inevitably contain factual errors due to noisy sources and extraction failures, and verifying them reliably at industrial scale remains a critical challenge. To address this, we propose AgentKGV, the Agentic LLM-RAG framework for KG fact Verification, that integrates dynamic routing and iterative query rewriting, which handles surface-form mismatch in document-level retrieval. To make this framework more accurate and cost-efficient for industrial deployment, we further introduce a two-stage training strategy: turn-level distillation-based SFT that transfers reasoning ability from a large teacher model into a small model for stable query rewriting and reasoning, and trajectory-level GRPO that optimizes the search policy to reduce unnecessary retrieval at scale. On the long-tail-predicate split of the open-domain T-REx benchmark, our framework improves macro-F1 over single-turn RAG by 5.5 \%p, and two-stage training does it further by 9.4 \%p. GRPO also cuts the average number of search calls from 3.24 to 1.63 without lowering accuracy.
2607.09092.paper_summary_zh: 知識圖譜（KGs）通常是從大規模語料庫自動構建的，但由於來源雜訊和提取失敗，它們不可避免地包含事實錯誤，並且在工業規模上可靠地驗證這些錯誤仍然是一個重大挑戰。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了AgentKGV，這是一個用於KG事實驗證的Agentic LLM-RAG框架，該框架整合了動態路由和迭代查詢重寫，能夠處理文檔級檢索中的表面形式不匹配。為了使這個框架在工業部署中更加準確和成本效益高，我們進一步引入了一種兩階段的訓練策略：基於回合的蒸餾式SFT，將大型教師模型的推理能力轉移到小型模型中，以實現穩定的查詢重寫和推理，以及軌跡級GRPO，優化搜索策略以減少不必要的檢索。在開放域T-REx基準的長尾謂詞分割上，我們的框架在宏觀F1指標上比單回合RAG提高了5.5 \%p，而兩階段訓練進一步提高了9.4 \%p。GRPO還將平均搜索調用次數從3.24減少到1.63，而不降低準確性。
